I also found a related correctness issue in the same reconstruction routine: when b0 denoising is skipped, it copies by the b0 counter instead of the original volume index, so interleaved b0/DWI inputs can silently reorder data. I’ll repair both paths in the shared output-buffer logic and validate mixed acquisitions explicitly.
